mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (id, room_id, sender, message, time) VALUES (chat_seq.NEXTVAL, #{roomId}, #{sender}, #{message}, #{time})
mapper.select: SELECT room_id, sender, message, time FROM chat_message WHERE room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT * FROM CHAT_ROOM WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} AND ((SELLER_NO = #{senderUserNo} AND BUYER_NO = #{receiverUserNo}) OR (SELLER_NO = #{receiverUserNo} AND BUYER_NO = #{senderUserNo}))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHAT_ROOM (ROOM_ID, PRODUCT_ID, SELLER_NO, BUYER_NO, CREATED_AT) VALUES (SEQ_CHAT_ROOM.NEXTVAL, #{productId}, #{receiverUserNo}, #{senderUserNo}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: WITH LAST_MSG AS ( SELECT ROOM_ID, MAX(MSG_ID) AS MAX_MSG_ID FROM CHAT_MESSAGE GROUP BY ROOM_ID ) SELECT R.ROOM_ID, R.PRODUCT_ID, R.SELLER_NO, R.BUYER_NO, R.CREATED_AT, CASE WHEN R.SELLER_NO = #{userNo} THEN R.BUYER_NO ELSE R.SELLER_NO END AS OTHER_USER_NO, M.MESSAGE AS LAST_MESSAGE, M.SENT_AT AS LAST_MESSAGE_TIME, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_MESSAGE WHERE ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID AND SENDER_NO != #{userNo} AND IS_READ = 'N' ) AS UNREAD_COUNT, PF.FILE_PATH AS PRODUCT_IMG, CASE WHEN R.SELLER_NO = #{userNo} THEN COALESCE(MPB.NICKNAME, UB.NAME) ELSE COALESCE(MPS.NICKNAME, US.NAME) END AS OTHER_USER_NAME FROM CHAT_ROOM R LEFT JOIN LAST_MSG LM ON LM.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID LEFT JOIN CHAT_MESSAGE M ON M.MSG_ID = LM.MAX_MSG_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_FILE PF ON R.PRODUCT_ID = PF.PRODUCT_ID AND PF.IS_MAIN = 1 JOIN USERS US ON R.SELLER_NO = US.USER_NO JOIN USERS UB ON R.BUYER_NO = UB.USER_NO LEFT JOIN MY_USER_PAGE MPS ON R.SELLER_NO = MPS.USER_NO LEFT JOIN MY_USER_PAGE MPB ON R.BUYER_NO = MPB.USER_NO WHERE (R.SELLER_NO = #{userNo} OR R.BUYER_NO = #{userNo}) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CHAT_MESSAGE CM WHERE CM.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID) ORDER BY COALESCE(M.SENT_AT, R.CREATED_AT) DESC

SELECT /*+ NO_PARALLEL(M) NO_PARALLEL(U) NO_PARALLEL(MP) */ M.MSG_ID, M.ROOM_ID, M.SENDER_NO, COALESCE(MP.NICKNAME, U.NAME) AS SENDER_NAME, M.MESSAGE, M.SENT_AT, M.IS_READ FROM CHAT_MESSAGE M JOIN USERS U ON M.SENDER_NO = U.USER_NO LEFT JOIN MY_USER_PAGE MP ON M.SENDER_NO = MP.USER_NO WHERE M.ROOM_ID = #{roomId} ORDER BY M.SENT_AT

SELECT CASE WHEN P.IS_DELETED = 'Y' THEN '삭제된 상품' ELSE P.PRODUCT_TITLE END AS PRODUCT_TITLE, CASE WHEN P.IS_DELETED = 'Y' THEN NULL ELSE P.PRODUCT_PRICE END AS PRODUCT_PRICE, CASE WHEN P.IS_DELETED = 'Y' THEN NULL ELSE PF.FILE_PATH END AS PRODUCT_IMG, P.IS_DELETED AS PRODUCT_DELETED, P.TRADE_STATUS AS TRADE_STATUS, CASE WHEN R.SELLER_NO = #{userNo} THEN COALESCE(MPB.NICKNAME, UB.NAME) ELSE COALESCE(MPS.NICKNAME, US.NAME) END AS OTHER_USER_NAME, CASE WHEN R.SELLER_NO = #{userNo} THEN UB.IS_DELETED ELSE US.IS_DELETED END AS OTHER_USER_DELETED FROM CHAT_ROOM R JOIN PRODUCT P ON R.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_FILE PF ON P.PRODUCT_ID = PF.PRODUCT_ID AND PF.IS_MAIN = 1 JOIN USERS US ON R.SELLER_NO = US.USER_NO JOIN USERS UB ON R.BUYER_NO = UB.USER_NO LEFT JOIN MY_USER_PAGE MPS ON R.SELLER_NO = MPS.USER_NO LEFT JOIN MY_USER_PAGE MPB ON R.BUYER_NO = MPB.USER_NO WHERE R.ROOM_ID = #{roomId}
mapper.update: UPDATE CHAT_MESSAGE SET IS_READ = 'Y' WHERE ROOM_ID = #{roomId} AND IS_READ = 'N' AND SENDER_NO = #{targetUserNo}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MP.NICKNAME, U.NAME) AS NAME, M.SENT_AT FROM USERS U JOIN CHAT_MESSAGE M ON U.USER_NO = M.SENDER_NO LEFT JOIN MY_USER_PAGE MP ON U.USER_NO = MP.USER_NO WHERE M.ROOM_ID = #{roomId} ORDER BY SENT_AT DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT R.ROOM_ID, R.PRODUCT_ID, R.SELLER_NO, R.BUYER_NO, CASE WHEN R.SELLER_NO = #{userNo} THEN R.BUYER_NO ELSE R.SELLER_NO END AS OTHER_USER_NO, ( SELECT MESSAGE FROM ( SELECT M.MESSAGE FROM CHAT_MESSAGE M WHERE M.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID ORDER BY M.MSG_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1 ) AS LAST_MESSAGE, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_MESSAGE M WHERE M.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID AND M.SENDER_NO != #{userNo} AND M.IS_READ = 'N' ) AS UNREAD_COUNT FROM CHAT_ROOM R WHERE R.ROOM_ID = #{roomId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_MESSAGE WHERE RECEIVER_NO = #{userNo} AND IS_READ = 'N'

SELECT CR.ROOM_ID, CR.BUYER_NO, U.NAME AS BUYER_NAME FROM CHAT_ROOM CR JOIN USERS U ON CR.BUYER_NO = U.USER_NO WHERE CR.PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} AND CR.SELLER_NO = #{userNo} AND U.IS_DELETED = 'N' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CHAT_MESSAGE CM WHERE CM.ROOM_ID = CR.ROOM_ID)
